# FarmMitra.Ai

> AI-powered crop recommendation and farm advisory platform for Indian farmers, with multilingual support (English, Hindi, Telugu), live weather and market insights.

FarmMitra.Ai helps farmers choose the right crops based on their locality, land area, soil type, water availability, budget, rainfall, and season. It provides AI-generated recommendations, a live weather and market dashboard, and a farming chatbot — all available in English, Hindi, and Telugu.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Enter farm details and get AI-powered crop recommendations, view live weather and market demand insights, and chat with the farming assistant.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Farmer account sign-in and sign-up to sync recommendation history across devices.
